metadata.neutral_citation: LI YIK WING v. SECRETARY FOR JUSTICE [2008] HKCFI 670
metadata.case_name: LI YIK WING v. SECRETARY FOR JUSTICE

plaintiff.occupation_before: Employed by the Marine Department as an artisan at the government dockyard at Stonecutters Island

injuries.description: significant direct contusion to his anterior chest wall with possible microfracture of the lateral right 6th rib
source: the plaintiff had suffered a significant direct contusion to his anterior chest wall with possible microfracture of the lateral right 6th rib and significant residue pain from the accident.

injuries.description: significant direct injury his lumbar spine with possible injury to his L3 upper endplate from the accident which also resulted in significant residue pain
injuries.body_part: lumbar spine (possible injury to L3 upper endplate)
source: the plaintiff also suffered a significant direct injury his lumbar spine with possible injury to his L3 upper endplate from the accident which also resulted in significant residue pain.

injuries.description: sprain injuries to the lumbar and cervical spine
source: contusion to the chest wall and sprain injuries to the lumbar and cervical spine

injuries.description: tenderness and bruising over bilateral chest wall and buttock
source: Medical examination revealed tenderness and bruising over bilateral chest wall and buttock.

manifestations.description: pain in head, neck, chest, waist, back and genitals and felt very dizzy
tenderness at bilateral lower chest wall
bruising over bilateral chest wall and buttock
low back pain and abdominal pain
urine frequency and urge incontinence and lower urinary tract symptoms including hesitancy and intermittent stream
adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressed mood

treatments_received: Attendance and treatment at A&E (Princess Margaret Hospital and Tuen Mun Hospital)
Admission to surgical ward of Tuen Mun Hospital (7 August 2003 to 11 August 2003)
Follow-up at surgical specialist outpatient department
Urology clinic follow-up and urodynamic studies
Psychiatric consultation and treatment (Castle Peak Hospital and other public hospitals)
Various medical consultations across departments (Orthopaedic & Traumatology, Family Medicine, Psychiatry, Medicine and Geriatric (Neurology))

losses.description: Pain suffering and loss of amenities (PSLA awarded by the court)
